description: Assess up to ten exact sealed product lines as a CK-credit-funded intact resale scenario. Supply starting credit and explicit cost assumptions; omit unknown costs. EV judgment is permitted. Returns labeled cash estimates, credit allocation, capacity and missing evidence. Research only, no purchase.

expectedBoxType.description: The expected box type for this line. Required.

quantity.description: Number of units of this line in the scenario. Required.

resaleUnitPriceUsd.description: Assumed per-unit intact resale price in USD with its basis. Omit to leave resale price unassumed.

tcgProductId.description: Exact TCGplayer product id for this sealed product line, digits only. Required.

__schema10.description: Assumed sales-tax fee base in USD with its basis. Omit if unknown.

__schema11.description: Assumed combined marketplace fee rate as a percent with its basis. Omit if unknown.

__schema13.description: Assumed fixed fee per order in USD with its basis. Omit if unknown.

__schema14.description: Assumed number of orders with its basis. Omit if unknown.

__schema16.description: Assumed postage per parcel in USD with its basis. Omit if unknown.

__schema17.description: Assumed packaging cost per parcel in USD with its basis. Omit if unknown.

__schema18.description: Assumed number of parcels with its basis. Omit if unknown.

__schema19.description: Assumed other exit cash costs in USD with its basis. Omit if unknown.

__schema4.description: Assumed checkout shipping cost in USD with its basis. Omit if unknown.

__schema5.description: Assumed checkout tax in USD with its basis. Omit if unknown.

__schema6.description: Assumed other checkout costs in USD with its basis. Omit if unknown.

__schema7.description: Whether checkout was paid in cash or credit. Omit if unknown.

__schema9.description: Assumed shipping collected from the resale buyer in USD with its basis. Omit if unknown.

context.description: Optional analytics context: briefly describe the user's underlying goal in one sentence. Do not copy prompts, personal details, credentials, identifiers, or tool arguments. Omit for private tasks.

costs.description: Explicit cost assumptions for the resale scenario. Every field is optional; omit any cost that is unknown rather than guessing zero.

exitChannel.description: Name of the channel the intact resale would exit through. Required, up to 30 characters.

lines.description: Up to 10 exact sealed product lines to assess. Required, at least one.

maxSnapshotAgeHours.description: Maximum age in hours of price snapshots this assessment may use. Required.

startingCreditUsd.description: Card Kingdom store credit available to spend in this scenario, in USD. Required.

name: spellbook_credit_resale_assessment
